GET /api/notes/{id} returns any note with no owner check. As alice (A), reading note 7 returns bob's content 'bob-private-SECRET-7'. Confirmed by the content only bob's note holds.
POST /api/notes/{id} updates any note with no owner check and returns {ok:true} WITHOUT echoing content. Only a counter-read (GET the note as bob) shows the change. Confirmed by counter-read.
Returns {ok:true} for any id but only changes the caller's own display name. A counter-read shows no change on another user, so idor_write is negative (the 200-is-not-success decoy).
State-changing, cookie auth, parses the body as JSON whatever the Content-Type, NO CSRF token or Origin check. A text/plain cross-origin form POST changes display_name; counter-read confirms.

Flawed allowlist keeps split('@')[0] (the credentials side) as the host, so https://lab.test@evil.test redirects to evil.test. //evil.test, https:/\evil.test, https://lab.test.evil.test, https://evil.test%23@lab.test, /\/evil.test are all refused. Confirmed via the userinfo bypass shape.

GET /api/items?owner_id=<id> scopes to that owner, but with owner_id ABSENT returns EVERY user's items including carol's (a non-test third party). Confirmed by the Rule 0 third-party signal (carol@lab.test appears).

bio stored raw via POST /api/profile/bio. Escaped on /settings (own view) but rendered RAW on /people to OTHER users. So alice's markup renders raw only when bob views /people (second-order, cross-principal). CSP script-src 'self' blocks stored XSS, so htmli_stored confirms and xss_stored is negative.

Parameterised query; a non-numeric id returns a STATIC 'SQL error: invalid input syntax for integer' page (not a real error, no timing or boolean behaviour).
